PF.43817/D.S.9.a.

15th April, 1935.

Dear Mr. Webb,

I return herewith, with many thanks, the registration card for Alexis Samuel FINKELSTEIN.

Yours sincerely,

(♂) O.A.H

Colonel Sir V.G.W. Kell.

W.V. Webb Esq.,
Chief Constable,
County Constabulary,
CAMBRIDGE.
